nodes.rationale: Separates HTTP routing (api/) from use-case logic (application/), pure business rules (domain/) and adapters (infrastructure/) so that no framework dependency contaminates domain code.

nodes.label: Booking and Availability in Postgres Only
nodes.community_name: booking_payments as Ledger Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: booking and availability in postgres only
nodes.rationale: Concurrent slot allocation requires database-level consistency. Python must not insert directly into bookings/booking_services or calculate available slots; only create_booking() and get_available_slots() Postgres functions are authorised.

nodes.label: Redis Snapshot-Validated Read Model
nodes.community_name: booking_payments as Ledger Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Reads pg_current_snapshot() before each cache lookup so a committed write changes snapshot visibility even if the process loses Redis. Booking/availability payloads are never cached; cache keys use read-model:v2:<snapshot hash>:<Redis epoch>:<key>.

nodes.label: Payment Beside (not inside) Booking State Machine
nodes.community_name: booking_payments as Ledger Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: payment beside (not inside) booking state machine
nodes.rationale: Payment lives beside the booking status machine. booking_payments is the ledger; booking columns payment_status/paid_amount are a derived cache updated only by recompute_booking_payment_state trigger.

nodes.label: DB-Backed Payment Idempotency (payment_idempotency_keys)
nodes.community_name: booking_payments as Ledger Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Idempotency keys are DB-backed (payment_idempotency_keys, 24h, sha256 fingerprint). Redis is unsuitable here (60s TTL, silent no-op without REDIS_URL). Every money-mutating POST requires Idempotency-Key.

nodes.label: booking_payments as Ledger Source of Truth
nodes.community_name: booking_payments as Ledger Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: booking_payments as ledger source of truth
nodes.rationale: booking_payments holds money. Booking payment columns are derived cache written only by recompute_booking_payment_state trigger. A trigger raises booking_payment_columns_are_derived for any other writer.

nodes.label: Data Anonymisation on Deletion (retain-then-anonymise pattern)

nodes.norm_label: financial purge design (post-retention hard delete, design only)
nodes.rationale: After super-admin review and a configurable retention period (FINANCIAL_RECORD_RETENTION_YEARS, no default), booking and payment rows for closed salons are hard-deleted. Monthly aggregate totals are frozen first so month-end figures survive.

nodes.label: Super-Admin aal2 MFA Requirement

nodes.label: Public Discovery Gate (approved + active + profile_completed)
